newsitem.title: GERMANY: Mercedes head hopes for Daimler agreement - report.
newsitem.headline: Mercedes head hopes for Daimler agreement - report.

text.p: Mercedes-Benz AG chairman Helmut Werner said on Wednesday that he saw a chance for an amicable resolution to a debate within Daimler-Benz AG on a massive restructuring plan.
In an interview with the Handelsblatt newspaper, Werner said "there is a chance for a resolution that will be satisfactory to all sides."
Daimler chairman Juergen Schrempp is pushing plans for a restructuring of Daimler that would bring individual units such as Mercedes closer within the group struture and reduce their independence.
Werner, whose unit is responsible for the bulk of Daimler's profits has opposed the plan and, according to press reports, has threatned to resign if Mercedes' independence were jeopardized.
Werner was quoted as saying that the high-profile debate should have been kept behind closed doors.
"I would have wished that the debate about this important topic would have been conducted internally," Werner said.
Daimler has said it will decide on the restructuring plan on January 23.
